## Definition in words

The broad residual of the disorder hierarchy: clinical observations that are neither a named disease nor a specific symptom. Legitimate at span level ("difficulty climbing stairs") but the noisiest type at word level, which is why it is excluded from `clinical_any` pending measurement.

A semantic-type partition of an anchored parent. The parent's boundary is validated; **the split within it is not adjudicated by any corpus**. Report the parent's metrics and label this as a refinement.
